text: Return their “weapon” to the offender. Currently, the point of view is popular that if, as a result of communicating with someone, you feel bad, then this is your problem, indicating that there is some imperfection in yourself that you need to correct. Of course, try to start with this. But if for a long time you continue to correct yourself, and the negative emotion connecting you with its source persists, and you are like a fish on a hook, then the time has come to change the metaphor... Accept that some people really are destructive. This can be seen if you look at how they live, how they build relationships with those around them. So, do the following—mentally imagine such a person. Feel the emotions that you experience as a result of interacting with them. And now feel what remains in you from this person—what leads to the appearance of your emotions. Most likely you will not be able to clearly see or somehow name what it is, but the main thing is that you feel it. Now feel that you have extracted this from somewhere inside yourself and are holding it in your hands. Clearly realize that this is not yours, that you are holding something from that person—their “gift.” And now, with love and compassion, return this object to that person. It is enough simply to offer it, and they will take it—because it is their burden, their “resource.” Feel how your hands become free, and how in your inner space the cause for negative emotions disappears, followed by the little cloud of these emotions, and then healing also occurs in the body. Sincerely forgive this person and let them go. You have your own path, they have theirs. Take several deep breaths in and out to fully recover.
